marklong.minecraft-servers.description: Save your Minecraft servers and see if they are online, how many players are on, who is playing, the ping, the software and the address. A Minecraft servers row appears in the + menu next to the message box.
marklong.minecraft-servers.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
contributors: Server data from mcstatus.io, mcsrvstat.us and minetools.eu (public status websites)

marklong.nef-viewer.name: Raw Viewer
marklong.nef-viewer.description: Shows RAW photos (Nikon, Canon, Sony, Fujifilm, Olympus, Panasonic, DNG and more) in chat, and adds an info button and swipe-up metadata sheet with a Google Maps link to every picture.
marklong.nef-viewer.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")

marklong.pin-dms.name: Pin DMs
marklong.pin-dms.description: Pin DMs and group chats to the top of your DM list, in coloured sections you can fold. Hold a DM and choose Pin DM, or use the plugin settings.
marklong.pin-dms.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")

marklong.rich-presence.name: Rich Presence
marklong.rich-presence.description: Fully customizable rich presence: profiles, every activity field, images, timer, party size, buttons and live text variables. Can show the track from SoundCloud Presence. Shows nothing until you set it up.
marklong.rich-presence.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")

marklong.role-options.name: Role Options
marklong.role-options.description: Adds Copy Role Name, Copy Role Color and Copy Role Icon to the role menu, and copies the color when you hold a role on a profile.

contributors: MSMA (https://github.com/Martinz64/vendetta-plugins "Original CopyRoleColor for Vendetta, public domain")

contributors: fshin (https://github.com/kmmiio99o/revenge-plugins "Original Server Info plugin for Revenge, CC0")

marklong.soundcloud-presence.description: Show the SoundCloud track you are listening to on your Discord profile, with artwork, a progress bar and a button. It follows your Last.fm now playing automatically (with a scrobbler such as Pano Scrobbler), or takes a pasted link, and can hand the track to your Rich Presence plugin.
